title: Agens
tagline: Make Governance Fun Again! (as the Romans did) Multi-agent take on analyzing and debating DAO governance proposals with human delegates
description:
Multi-agent take on analyzing and debating DAO governance proposals with human delegates. 
What's built? 
1) React webapp to demo the agents debating on topics/proposals for 5 rounds.
2) Integrations with twitter and discord for public debate showdown
3) Built another discord bot integration, can be directly added to a discord server - demo's 2  agents that can be summoned on a discord server for DAO proposal deliberation and debate, engaging also with human delegates 

What's Integrated? 
1) Twitter/X and Discord besides UX for debates.
2) Base
3) CDP kit for wallet

Roadmap for continued launch and feature updates:
https://daisy-beetle-8d3.notion.site/PRD-19112a33330780bfa402fcc0a9b8fa1f?pvs=4
how_its_made:
Current tech stack - 
1) AI LLM API integration [OpenAI and Anthropic, working on Gaianet]
2) Full stack webapp with react next js and backend server with api routes and wrappers
3) Integrate wallet for discord bots, using CDP wallet-kit [prize submission]
4) Base integration for onchain agent activity [prize submission]
6) API integration for discord
7) API integration for twitter
8) Eliza framework for discord bots with 2 characters

Integrations still WIP [not submitting for prize]: 
1) Use of Gaianet models beyond OpenAI/Anthropic
2) Use of Collabland agent-kit
